defs.def: attractive and showing a good sense of style 人或其举止
attractive and designed well 衣服、地方和物品

ex.s: Serving hard-to-find Thai dishes in an elegant atmosphere, the restaurant is true to Thai cuisine’s roots, yet still manages to add a special twist.
ex.t: 餐厅在优雅的氛围中供应难觅的泰式菜肴，既忠于泰菜的本源，又巧妙增添了特别的变化。

ex.s: I must have always known reading was very important because the first memories I have as a child deal with books． There was not one night that I don't remember mom reading me a storybook by my bedside． I was extremely inspired by the elegant way the words sounded．
ex.t: 我一定一直都知道阅读非常重要，因为我童年最早的记忆都与书有关。没有哪个夜晚我不记得妈妈在床边给我读故事书。那些文字优雅的读音极大地启发了我。

ex.s: In each place we went, we experienced wonderful local dishes, from Guangdong’s elegant dim sum—small servings of food in bamboo steamers—to the exceptional stewed noodles in Henan.
ex.t: 在我们去的每一个地方，我们都品尝到了美妙的当地菜肴，从广东精致的点心——放在竹蒸笼里的小份食物——到河南独特的烩面。

ex.s: She told him how she was unhappy that her home wasn’t elegant enough for Larry, who wanted to improve his social position with a bigger salary.
ex.t: 她告诉他，她很不开心，因为她的家不够雅致，配不上拉里，而拉里想靠更高的薪水来提升自己的社会地位。

ex.s: As a favour, Tony promised to help Claire make herself more beautiful and her home more elegant.
ex.t: 作为一个人情，托尼答应帮克莱尔让自己变得更漂亮，让她的家变得更加雅致。

ex.s: Aband performance Adanceperformance Aexhibition amazing colourful wonderful exciting energetic elegant talented modern traditional special interesting Example I like going to rock concerts, because they are really energetic and exciting.
ex.t: 一个乐队表演 一个舞蹈表演 一个展览 令人惊叹的 五彩缤纷的 精彩的 令人兴奋的 充满活力的 优雅的 有才华的 现代的 传统的 特别的 有趣的 例子 我喜欢去摇滚音乐会，因为它们真的充满活力和令人兴奋。

defs.def: clever but simple 计划或想法

ex.s: Catamarans are faster, but they’re not so elegant, and they’re not fun to pilot.
ex.t: 双体船速度更快，但不那么优雅，驾驶起来也不好玩。

ex.s: Finally, I conducted an elegant experiment that would not have been possible without the help of the members in the lab.
ex.t: 最终，我进行了一项精巧的实验，若没有实验室成员们的帮助，这项实验是不可能完成的。
